name: rosetta-left-factorials
code:
use default

left_factorials() -> Ghul.Pipes.Pipe[bigint] =>
    stream(
        (n = 0, factorial = 1n, total = 0n),
        ((n, factorial, total)) =>
            total || (n + 1, factorial * cast(n + 1), total + factorial)
    )

write_line("left factorials !0 through !10, then every tenth up to !110:")

left_factorials()
    |> index()
    |> take_while((n, _) => n <= 110)
    |> filter((n, _) => n <= 10 \/ (n >= 20 /\ n % 10 == 0))
    |> each((n, left) => write_line("!{n} = {left}"))

write_line("digit counts of !1000 through !10000, by thousands:")

left_factorials()
    |> index()
    |> take_while((n, _) => n <= 10000)
    |> filter((n, _) => n >= 1000 /\ n % 1000 == 0)
    |> each((n, left) =>
        write_line("!{n} has {left.to_string().length} digits"))
